description: Return simulated hex values for full-severity protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia only, using the Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes (2009) model (severity 1.0, linear sRGB), with a flag when a simulated colour had to be clipped to sRGB. Anomalous trichromacy and partial severities are not simulated. A model prediction on a standard display, not how an individual perceives colour.
name: accessibility_simulate

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an 'ok' boolean plus a 'result' or 'results' field with the tool's data payload.

title: Simulate Colour Blindness
